article.title_es: JESUS Reconciliation Ministries: despensa de alimentos en el Bronx
article.title_en: JESUS Reconciliation Ministries: food pantry in the Bronx
article.summary_es: JESUS Reconciliation Ministries es una despensa de alimentos en el Bronx, en la avenida Barnes. Abre los sábados de 12pm a 2pm, solo el segundo y el cuarto sábado del mes.
article.summary_en: JESUS Reconciliation Ministries is a food pantry in the Bronx, on Barnes Avenue. It is open Saturdays from 12pm to 2pm, on the 2nd and 4th Saturday only.
how_they_help_es: Es una despensa de alimentos que aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC.
Está en 4051 Barnes Ave, Bronx, NY 10466.
Abre los sábados de 12pm a 2pm, solo el segundo y el cuarto sábado del mes.
La lista no indica qué alimentos entrega ni si hay requisitos.
how_they_help_en: It is a food pantry listed on the Food Help NYC map.
It is located at 4051 Barnes Ave, Bronx, NY 10466.
It is open Saturdays from 12pm to 2pm, on the 2nd and 4th Saturday only.
The listing does not say what food is given or if there are requirements.
visit_tips_es: Vaya un sábado, porque solo abre de 12pm a 2pm.
Recuerde que solo atiende el segundo y el cuarto sábado de cada mes.
Llame antes al (718) 844-8704 para confirmar que está abierta.
visit_tips_en: Go on a Saturday, since it is only open from 12pm to 2pm.
Remember it is open only on the 2nd and 4th Saturday of each month.
Call ahead at (718) 844-8704 to confirm it is open.
